title: Ep 1: The Signal Speaks
summary: The crew detects a strange frequency from the neutron star that whispers Mara's name. Commander Hale tries to dismiss it, but the static repeats her identity.

title: Ep 2: The Countdown Begins
summary: Jin traces the strange signal to a neutron star forty light-years away, where a mysterious countdown suddenly begins on the main display.

title: Ep 3: Orders of Silence
summary: Commander Hale orders complete silence as power drops and station lights begin flickering in sync with the countdown.

title: Ep 4: Seven Crew. Eight Voices.
summary: An eighth voice echoes inside the locked control deck, terrifying the crew when they realize only seven of them are present.

title: Ep 5: The Old Pattern
summary: Dr. Ruth recognizes the mysterious pulse pattern from classified station archives recorded decades ago. The crew must choose whether to decode the old distress call or erase the archives.

title: Ep 6: The Sixty-Year Log
summary: Jin uncovers a hidden log timestamped sixty years ago that is actively broadcasting from inside the station. The crew must choose whether to open the file or purge the server.

title: Ep 7: Her Own Script
summary: The crew discovers the sixty-year-old log is written in Mara's handwriting, ending with a cryptic warning about Commander Hale.

title: Ep 8: Sealed In
summary: Voss seals the station following the suspicious log warning, but the main door locks permanently and air levels begin to drop.

title: Ep 9: The Countdown Pauses
summary: The terrifying countdown rapidly ticks down and abruptly freezes at one thousand, leaving the trapped crew in an unnerving silence.

title: Ep 10: Glimpse of Future
summary: The Eighth reveals terrifying visions of each crew member's future on the viewports.

title: Ep 11: Mission Aborted
summary: Commander Hale attempts to abort the mission after the future visions, but the station locks controls and steers toward the star.

title: Ep 12: Sleepwalking Mara
summary: Mara enters a trance state and sleepwalks directly to the signal console, bypassing locked security controls.

title: Ep 13: Echoes of the Blueprint
summary: Jin decodes the neutron star signal and discovers it is actually a detailed 3D schematic of their own station.

title: Ep 14: The Second Station
summary: A second station identical to theirs appears on the sensors. The crew must decide whether to contact it or flee.

title: Ep 15: The Vanished Crew
summary: Ruth reveals the original station crew vanished sixty years ago at this star. Now, the twin station extends a docking tube toward them.

title: Ep 16: The Forgotten Quarters
summary: Voss forces open a long-sealed wing of the station, revealing eight bunks instead of seven. The team stares in horror as they realize the eighth bed is labeled for Mara.

title: Ep 17: Her Name on the Bunk
summary: Mara finds her own name and biometric data on the eighth bunk from sixty years ago. Inside the bunk's locker, an old recorder is actively playing her voice.

title: Ep 18: Counting the Missing Years
summary: Mara realizes her past memories are completely gone before compulsively counting the crew members again. The crew must decide whether to quarantine her or let her continue.

title: Ep 19: The Reply
summary: Hale sends a distress beacon to Earth, only to receive an instant reply spoken in his own voice. The crew must decide whether to answer or cut comms.

title: Ep 20: The Silent Reflection
summary: The power fails completely, and the crew spots a mysterious silhouette in the emergency lights. They must decide how to confront the entity before it reaches them.

title: Ep 21: The Eighth's Deal
summary: The crew turns on each other after the Eighth offers a single escape pod, resulting in a tense vote.

title: Ep 22: The Deadlock Vote
summary: The vote for the escape pod ends in a tie, causing the station's system to take drastic control.

title: Ep 23: Jin's Sacrifice
summary: Jin vents his oxygen supply to force open a jammed vent, allowing Mara to crawl through before his suit air runs out.

title: Ep 24: Split in Two
summary: The station splits into two identical copies, each claiming to be the original. The crew must choose whether to dock with the duplicate or break away.

title: Ep 25: The Invitation
summary: Dr. Ruth decodes the strange signal from the neutron star and reveals it is a direct invitation. The crew must decide whether to venture into the star's core or attempt to flee.

title: Ep 26: The Other Mara
summary: Mara realizes the Eighth voice belongs to a version of herself from another timeline attempting to cross over. Hale steps in as Mara prepares to make contact.
